title: INFO511 Lab 3 Q4 synthetic-v1: draft instructor rubric

criteria.description: Review the submitted table against every synthetic source cell; preserve keys, years, values and missingness. Cite CSV source lines from the same captured submitted commit; inspect all values with the deterministic checker evidence.
Review learner-authored checks and notebook reasoning, not a checkbox or monitoring flag.
Review the self-written explanation of at most 150 words and reproducibility of the submitted notebook.
Review the explicit assistance declaration. A valid no_ai declaration meets this requirement; optional monitoring is not required.
